# sendgrid_segment (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid Marketing Campaigns contact segment: a dynamic group of contacts matching a SQL-like query.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_segment" "active_customers" {
  name      = "active-customers"
  query_dsl = "last_opened > '2024-01-01'"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The segment's name. Must be unique across all segments in the account.
- `query_dsl` (String) The SQL-like query used to filter contacts into this segment.

### Optional

- `parent_list_ids` (List of String) Restricts this segment to contacts on these list IDs. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Read-Only

- `contacts_count` (Number) The number of contacts currently matching this segment.
- `id` (String) The segment's UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_segment.active_customers <segment_id>
```
